summary: Hydrofarm Holdings Group filed a 424B5 prospectus-supplement amendment correcting dilution figures for its registered direct offering of 1,599,400 common shares plus a concurrent private placement of 6,971,575 shares, warrants for up to 9,210,975 shares, and pre-funded warrants for up to 640,000 shares, all placed with institutional investors through ThinkEquity. The amendment restates pro forma net tangible book value per share as of June 30, 2026 after the offering and related term-loan payoff. This is a routine capital-raise dilution correction, not a special situation; watch warrant overhang and dilution mechanics rather than any deal spread.
